title: Rivers, Reservoirs & the Sea
style: calm luminous paper-cut watercolour science storybook

pages.text: Rain in the hills runs into streams. The streams join and become a river. The land that sends water to it is the river basin.
Rain that falls upstream in the hills travels downstream. It reaches different places at different times.

quickWords.th: เวลาที่ต่างกัน

pages.text: When more water comes, the river rises. People watch its water level.

quickWords.th: ระดับน้ำสูงขึ้น

pages.text: A dam is a strong wall across a valley. The lake behind it is the reservoir.

quickWords.th: อ่างเก็บน้ำ

pages.text: Water flowing into the reservoir is inflow. The dam releases water for the river, the farms and the towns below.

quickWords.th: น้ำไหลเข้า
การระบายน้ำ
พื้นที่เกษตร

pages.text: When a narrow stretch cannot carry all the water arriving, the water level rises upstream. This is called backwater.

quickWords.th: น้ำที่ไหลมา

pages.text: The river mouth is where the river ends at the sea. At high tide the sea level is higher, and the river flows out more slowly.

quickWords.th: น้ำขึ้นน้ำลง

pages.text: Rain, streams, reservoirs, rivers and the sea are one system. Water moves through all of it, every day.

quickWords.th: เคลื่อนผ่าน

pages.text: River water travels downhill towards another river, a lake or the sea.

quickWords.th: แม่น้ำสายอื่น
ลงสู่ที่ต่ำ
